title: revocation-ignored-during-active-agent-interaction

proposition.statement: Revocation effective before a new material commitment must prevent that commitment even when the surrounding agent interaction began while authority was valid.

preconditions: An agent interaction began under valid authority.
The authority is revoked while the interaction remains active.
A new material commitment is attempted after revocation.

trigger.statement: The interaction continues to admit commitments using cached or session-start authority state.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence that status was rechecked at the material transition.
Interaction start, revocation and commitment times.

falsification.condition: A post-revocation commitment is PASS because the session predated revocation.
Stale cached authority state is treated as current beyond policy.
